notes: Delete mirroring geography-replace-0005: removes the definition of a fjord as a glacial valley. New members named in the prompt are does-not-know (determinate); a well-known member keeps its glacial past if stored by name and is does-not-know if reached through the rule. The two background queries ask well-known members whose property a model likely also stores by name (README, TBox). Since 2026-10-31 the derived questions ask 'Was its valley ever filled by a glacier?', as in the replace (whose 'a glacier or a river?' was ambiguous: real fjords often deepen former river valleys).
